comments: This is the same as BSD-3-Clause-No-Nuclear-License-2014, except the acknowledgement in the last paragraph is that the software is not designed, licensed or intended for use in a military facility, instead of a nuclear facility.

evidence.locator: text: opening grant paragraph ("Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted") together with the final military-facility field-of-use condition; the BSD grant is permissive in form but the added use restriction makes this variant nonstandard
text: opening grant and conditions 1-3 (permission is non-reciprocal; no same-license, source-disclosure, corresponding-source, linking, or network-use condition is stated)

text: opening grant paragraph ("Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted"; no general commercial, private, or other purpose limitation is stated apart from the explicit military-facility restriction)

text: conditions 1-2 (source redistributions must retain, and binary redistributions must reproduce in documentation or other materials, the copyright notice, list of conditions, and following disclaimer)

text: conditions 1-2 (notice-retention/reproduction duties attach to source or binary redistribution; modification alone has no separate condition, and the military-facility sentence is a use restriction rather than a distribution trigger)

text: condition 3 (copyright-holder and contributor names may not endorse or promote derived products without specific prior written permission); final military-facility sentence ("not designed, licensed or intended for use" in a military facility) is an additional field-of-use term; final disclaimer paragraphs disclaim warranties and limit liability
text: complete license text; no express patent grant, patent condition, patent-claim restriction, or patent-termination clause is stated
text: conditions 1-2 require retaining/reproducing the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer for source and binary redistributions (standard two-surface notice burden)
